title: Skill portability manifest (schema_version 1)
description: Per-skill declaration of compatible hosts. Drives scripts/sync-host-skills.sh fan-out — only declared hosts get a symlink in their discovery dir. Default for unmigrated skills (no portability.yaml): hosts: [claude-code]; new-host fan-out is opt-in, not opt-out.

hosts.description: Host slugs from hosts/registry.yaml that this skill runs on.

additionalProperties.description: Rationale for the incompatibility. Mandatory; never silent exclusion.

incompatible.description: Map of host-slug → human-readable reason this skill cannot run there.
